changelog: The Facebook Buy Scout is wired up end-to-end. In the Project Snake extension there's now a 🔎 Buy Scout panel on Marketplace: set year/price/max-km and how many cars to open, hit Scout, and it scrolls the results, filters them, opens each keeper to read the km (+ transmission, colours, fuel, VIN, description), and drops them straight into your Cars to Buy list — no messaging, human-paced, one tab. Snake's Hustle now receives that scout hand-off automatically.
